'''Septsilk''' was an expensive cloth used to make fine clothing. [[Uta S'orn]] and [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] were known for their fondness of wearing septsilk clothing, as were the infamous [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] scientists [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] and [[Jenna Zan Arbor]]. [[Valin Draco]] was also known to wear scarlet robes made out of septsilk once he became an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]].
